question: What are the target company's revenue metrics for the latest year?
cypher:
MATCH (tc:TargetCompany)-[:HAS_METRIC_CATEGORY]->(mc:MetricCategory)-[:HAS_METRIC]->(m:Metric)
WHERE mc.name = 'Profitability'
  AND m.name IN [
    'Research and development expenses as a percentage of net sales (2023)',
    'Research and development expenses as a percentage of net sales (2024)',
    'Marketing and administrative expenses (2023)',
    'Marketing and administrative expenses (2024)',
    'Consumer & Specialties Segment sales (2023)'
  ]
WITH tc, m
ORDER BY m.year DESC
RETURN tc.name AS company, m.name AS metric, m.value AS value, m.year AS year, m.unit AS unit, m.metric_type AS metric_type, m.xbrl_tag AS xbrl_tag, m.label AS label

risk.name: Competition from better-resourced entities
risk.description: Competitors with greater financial resources, technical expertise, or local industry knowledge may outbid the company for target businesses.
risk.why: Other entities, including private investors and blank check companies, have more resources and industry knowledge, and the company’s limited financial capacity restricts its ability to compete for sizable targets.

risk.name: FINRA suitability requirements limiting broker recommendations
risk.description: FINRA rules make it harder for brokers to recommend speculative low-priced stocks, reducing demand and liquidity for the company's shares.
risk.why: Brokers must assess customer suitability before recommending such securities, and FINRA believes speculative low-priced stocks are unsuitable for many customers, limiting buy recommendations.

risk.name: Short operating history and minimal revenue
risk.description: The company has a limited operating history and has generated minimal revenue, making it difficult to evaluate its prospects.
risk.why: Incorporated in August 2015, the company lacks sufficient historical data for investors to assess viability, increasing uncertainty about its success in a new industry with no established comparables.

Operating Costs and Expenses

Consolidated cost of sales was $1,570.8 million, $1,662.8 million and $1,660.5 million in 2024, 2023 and 2022, respectively. Production margin as a percentage of net sales was 25.9% in 2024, 23.4% in 2023 and 21.9% in 2022. Production margin increased in 2024 primarily due to improved pricing, lower input costs and higher productivity.

Marketing and administrative costs were $209.2 million, $206.0 million and $192.1 million in 2024, 2023 and 2022, respectively. Marketing and administrative costs as a percentage of net sales were 9.9% in 2024, 9.5% in 2023 and 9.0% in 2022.

Research and development expenses were $23.0 million, $21.2 million and $20.4 million in 2024, 2023 and 2022, respectively. Research and development expenses as a percentage of net sales were 1.1% in 2024, 1.0% in 2023 and 1.0% in 2022.
